stages.title: Review milestone PRs
stages.summary: Reviews every open PR in the milestone (one subagent per PR), audits the milestone’s issues, and writes a review file per PR plus an index.

stages.title: Compare build with last release
stages.summary: Compares the Pro and Lite zips with the last release, to catch missing assets and stray files before shipping. Uses the release branch’s CI build, or a local build from the Builds page.
gates: Compare a stale build, or dispatch a fresh one (CI build only)

stages.title: Draft changelog & analysis
stages.summary: Reads every change since the last tag and writes the release analysis, changelog draft and PR body. Also updates docs/PRODUCT.md.

stages.title: Bump version & changelog
stages.summary: Checks out the release branch, bumps the version, writes the changelog into both readmes, replaces {next} tags and writes the marketing site changes report.
gates: Approve or edit the changelog entries

blockedUntil.reason: Run Draft changelog & analysis first. {analysisFile} does not exist yet.

stages.title: Update customer docs
stages.summary: Updates the customer docs in docs-user/ for this release, captures screenshots and syncs the docs to the marketing site.
gates: Confirm the scope of changes
Approve the plan of articles to add or update
Start the marketing site in Local if it is stopped

blockedUntil.reason: Run Draft changelog & analysis first. {analysisFile} does not exist yet.

stages.title: Open docs PR on marketing site
stages.summary: After Update customer docs: clones the marketing site repo into a temporary folder, copies docs-user/ into plugins/wpsp-docs/docs-user/ while keeping the site’s published slugs, opens the sync PR and removes the temporary folder.
gates: Approve any deleted articles or broken URLs
Confirm the PR before it is pushed and opened

blockedUntil.reason: Run Draft changelog & analysis first. {analysisFile} does not exist yet.

stages.title: Write marketing content
stages.summary: Writes the blog post first, then the featured image (generated in Chatty through your Chrome), newsletter, social posts, Slack posts and in-plugin notifications in parallel.
gates: Pick the blog title and approve the section plan
Sign in to Chatty in Chrome if needed (for the featured image)

blockedUntil.reason: Run Draft changelog & analysis first. {analysisFile} does not exist yet.

stages.title: Create blog post draft
stages.summary: Creates the release post as a draft on wpsimplepay.com through your logged-in Chrome session: uploads the screenshots, sets the featured image and fills the SEO fields. Never publishes.
gates: Confirm the screenshots and post details before anything is uploaded
Log in to wpsimplepay.com in Chrome if needed

blockedUntil.reason: Run Write marketing content first. blog.html does not exist yet.
Run Write marketing content first. The featured image does not exist yet.

stages.title: Draft email campaign
stages.summary: Creates the release announcement as a draft campaign in Lindris through your logged-in Chrome session, with the newsletter, subject, preview text and sender. Never sends or schedules: it disables every send button in the page first, and saves with plain Save only. The console refuses any send, schedule or send-test click, any script that re-enables those buttons, and any write request from the page, with no way to approve them.
gates: Approve the campaign before anything is created
Log in to Lindris in Chrome if needed

blockedUntil.reason: Run Write marketing content first. newsletter.html does not exist yet.

stages.title: Draft in-plugin notifications
stages.summary: Creates the Pro and Lite in-plugin notifications as drafts on plugin.wpsimplepay.com through your logged-in Chrome session, with the right licenses, buttons and dates. Never publishes: it removes the Publish button from the page before filling anything, and saves with Save Draft only.
gates: Approve both notifications before anything is created
Log in to plugin.wpsimplepay.com in Chrome if needed

blockedUntil.reason: Run Write marketing content first. notification-pro.html does not exist yet.
Run Write marketing content first. notification-lite.html does not exist yet.

stages.title: Preview in-plugin notifications
stages.summary: Imports the draft in-plugin notifications into the local site and shows the Lite and Pro variants in the admin, then cleans up.

stages.title: Publish Pro release on GitHub
stages.summary: Tags the version on master and publishes the Pro GitHub release with the build attached. Checks the release PR has merged first. Permanent and public.
gates: Confirm the tag and release notes before publishing

stages.title: Sync release to Lite repo
stages.summary: Copies the release from Pro’s build into the Lite checkout, commits it on Lite’s release branch and opens Lite’s release PR.
gates: Confirm creating Lite’s release branch if it does not exist

stages.title: Publish Lite release on GitHub
stages.summary: After Lite’s release PR has merged: tags Lite’s master and publishes the public Lite GitHub release with its zip. Permanent and public.
gates: Confirm before tagging and publishing

blockedUntil.reason: Run Sync release to Lite repo first. There is no Lite checkout at {litePath}.

stages.title: Publish Lite to WordPress.org
stages.summary: Stages Lite’s GitHub Release zip into the wp.org SVN trunk and reports what changed. After you approve, commits trunk and tags the version on plugins.svn.wordpress.org. Permanent and public: it ships to every Lite site.
gates: Review the staged trunk, then reply to commit and tag
Enter your wp.org SVN password in a terminal if it is not cached

localWpSite.notFound: The wpsp-docs folder is not inside a Local site, so the sync cannot reach its database.
localWpSite.stopped: {site} is stopped. Start it in Local before the docs sync.

messages.browser-write: Sends a write request from your logged-in browser, for example to wpsimplepay.com.
messages.svn-commit: Commits or tags on wp.org SVN. It ships to every Lite site with auto-updates on.
messages.browser-send: Sends or schedules an email from your logged-in browser. A campaign goes to every subscribed contact and cannot be unsent.
messages.browser-publish: Publishes a post from your logged-in browser. A published in-plugin notification goes to every WP Simple Pay site.

extra.reason: Writes docs into the marketing site database.
`npm run build` runs `grunt clean`, which deletes vendor/ and composer.lock and breaks the local site until `composer install`. `npx wp-scripts build` builds assets without that.
